verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a law firm can publish startup guides, but the evidence shows no startup-focused knowledge base of guides or explainers on formation, financing, or equity. The Prarambh FAQs only cover the incubator's own logistics (cohort length, eligibility, mentorship). The blogs hub is a general legal-updates channel with no shown startup formation, financing, or equity content. Both are adjacent, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm maintains an open startup knowledge base — plain-language guides, FAQs, or explainers on formation, financing, and equity — on its own public pages
